question: Which 2025 vampire film set an all-time record at the 2026 Oscars with sixteen nominations?
source_excerpt: Sinners received a record sixteen nominations and won four awards.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a genre horror film could never hold the all-time Oscar nominations record; a vampire movie did exactly that.
extra.verification_notes: Sinners (2025), a vampire film directed by Ryan Coogler, received a record 16 Oscar nominations at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026, surpassing the prior record of 14; confirmed by Variety and NPR.

explanation: The bloodsoaked thriller out-nominated every film in Academy history and took home four statuettes on the night.

question: Which film had the bigger opening weekend in the United States and Canada: Avengers: Endgame in 2019, or Spider-Man: Brand New Day in 2026?
source_excerpt: Spider-Man: Brand New Day had the biggest opening weekend ever in the United States and Canada with $360 million, outdoing Avengers: Endgame (2019).

extra.why_interesting: Endgame's opening felt untouchable as the end of a decade-long saga; a solo Spider-Man film quietly beat it.
extra.verification_notes: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opened to $360M domestically in August 2026, surpassing Avengers: Endgame's $357.1M opening, per Variety and Deadline.

explanation: Brand New Day opened to three hundred and sixty million dollars, taking the domestic opening record that Endgame had held since 2019.

question: Which famous British music festival skipped 2026 entirely to give its farmland a rest, a so-called fallow year?
source_excerpt: There will be no Glastonbury in 2026 as the Festival is taking a fallow year.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a festival this huge would never voluntarily skip a year; it does, and the reason is literally agricultural.
extra.verification_notes: Glastonbury Festival confirmed no 2026 edition, a fallow year to let Worthy Farm's land recover, per NME and organiser statements; next festival is June 2027.

explanation: The festival takes place on a working farm and periodically takes a year off so the fields and the local community can recover.

question: Netflix's biggest title of the first half of 2026, War Machine, drew roughly how many views in those six months?
source_excerpt: War Machine was Netflix’s biggest title in the first half of 2026 with 147 million views.

extra.why_interesting: Players tend to underestimate streaming scale; the top Netflix title of early 2026 pulled a number bigger than the population of most countries.
extra.verification_notes: Netflix's own H1 2026 engagement report confirms War Machine had 146.9 million views, the highest of any title (film or series) that period, consistent with 'well over one hundred million' (https://www.thewrap.com/creative-content/tv-shows/netflix-most-watched-movies-shows-first-half-2026-his-and-hers-war-machine/)

explanation: Netflix reported one hundred and forty-seven million views, more people than live in Russia.

question: The first film of 2026 to pass one billion dollars worldwide was based on which video game franchise?
source_excerpt: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie became the first film of 2026 to cross $1 billion.

extra.why_interesting: Players expect a superhero or Avatar-style epic to be the year's first billion-dollar film; a plumber from a video game got there first.
extra.verification_notes: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, based on the Super Mario video game franchise, was confirmed by Deadline and Variety as the first 2026 release to cross $1 billion worldwide (achieved in June 2026), and no earlier 2026 film reached that mark.

explanation: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie beat every superhero and sequel to the billion-dollar mark that year.

question: Tomorrowland, the giant electronic music festival that runs over two weekends every July, takes place in which country?
source_excerpt: Tomorrowland Belgium 2026 took place on Weekend 1: July 17-19, 2026 and Weekend 2: July 24-26, 2026.

extra.why_interesting: Players associate giant EDM festivals with Ibiza, Miami or Las Vegas; the world's most famous one is in a small European country not known for party culture.
extra.verification_notes: Tomorrowland remains a Belgian festival, held over two weekends in July at De Schorre, Boom, Belgium, including confirmed 2026 dates (July 17-19 and 24-26) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomorrowland_(festival)

explanation: The festival is so popular it is split across two full weekends in July, and fans fly in from every continent.

question: True or false: at the 2026 Academy Awards, a woman won the Oscar for Best Cinematography for the first time in history.
source_excerpt: Best Cinematography winner Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first female and Black winner in the category

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a category nearly a century old must have had a female winner by now; it took until 2026.
extra.verification_notes: Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for 'Sinners' at the March 15, 2026 ceremony, confirmed as the first woman to win this Oscar category by NBC News, Variety, and PBS (https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture/awards/oscars-best-cinematography-sinners-autumn-durald-arkapaw-first-woman-rcna262815).

explanation: Autumn Durald Arkapaw broke the barrier in 2026, nearly a hundred years after the category was created.

question: The 2026 Disney Plus series Star Wars: Shadow Lord is built around which classic villain?
source_excerpt: Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord released on April 6, 2026, with a two-episode premiere.

extra.why_interesting: Players remember this villain being cut in half in 1999 and assume his story ended there; in 2026 he got his own series.
extra.verification_notes: The series' official title is 'Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord' (premiered Disney+ April 6, 2026), and its central villain is confirmed to be Darth Maul, voiced by Sam Witwer, per IMDb and Disney's official press release.

explanation: The horned Sith from The Phantom Menace returned as the lead of his own show, which premiered with two episodes in April 2026.

question: Which rapper became Spotify's most-streamed artist in a single day of 2026 after dropping three surprise albums at once?
source_excerpt: Drake became the most-streamed artist in a single day of 2026 after releasing three surprise albums.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume surprise drops are one album at a time; one star dropped three at once and broke Spotify's single-day record for the year.
extra.verification_notes: Multiple authoritative outlets confirm Drake became Spotify's most-streamed artist in a single day of 2026 after simultaneously dropping Iceman, Maid of Honour, and Habibti on May 15, 2026, and no later 2026 event has been reported to overtake this record (https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/drake-iceman-2026-spotify-record-single-day-album-streams-1236249717/).

explanation: Releasing three albums with no warning flooded playlists worldwide and handed him the biggest streaming day of any artist that year.

question: The 2026 box-office hit Obsession, one of the most profitable films ever made, was produced on a budget closest to which amount?
source_excerpt: one of the most profitable in history having been produced on a $750,000 budget.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a record-breaking hit costs tens of millions; this one cost less than a modest house in many cities.
extra.verification_notes: Multiple sources (Variety, Fox/OutKick, ScreenRant, saturation.io) confirm Obsession's budget was $750,000, consistent with 'under one million dollars', per https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/obsession-box-office-breakout-hit-horror-1236757946/

explanation: It was made for around seven hundred and fifty thousand dollars, then became its studio's biggest domestic release ever.

question: Shakira's 2026 World Cup anthem Dai Dai, the first official World Cup song ever to top Billboard's global chart, paired her with which Afrobeats superstar?
source_excerpt: Shakira and Burna Boy’s "Dai Dai" rose to No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200 in the chart dated July 18, 2026, making it the first official FIFA World Cup anthem to simultaneously top both Billboard global charts.

extra.why_interesting: Players link Shakira with Latin pop collaborators; her record-setting 2026 anthem paired her with an African star instead.
extra.verification_notes: Multiple authoritative sources (FIFA.com, NPR, Billboard, Wikipedia) confirm Burna Boy as Shakira's collaborator on the official 2026 World Cup song 'Dai Dai'.

explanation: The Colombian and Nigerian stars hit number one on the Billboard Global 200 in July 2026, days before performing the first ever World Cup halftime show.

question: Which Californian desert festival sold out for 2026 less than a week after announcing its lineup?
alternative_answers: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
source_excerpt: the Coachella Music Festival 2026 had officially sold out less than a week after the festival unveiled its full lineup.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a festival with a hundred-thousand-plus crowd takes months to sell; in 2026 it was gone within days of the lineup reveal.
extra.verification_notes: Coachella (Indio, CA, Colorado Desert) announced its full 2026 lineup ~Sept 15-16, 2025, and both weekends sold out by Sept 22-23, 2025, confirming the sub-week sellout claim; see https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/coachella-2026-sold-out-1235432769/

explanation: Demand was so high that tickets vanished within days of the poster going public, months before the gates opened in April.

question: Which city hosted the seventieth Eurovision Song Contest in May 2026?
source_excerpt: Victoria Swarovski and Michael Ostrowski were announced as the hosts of the 70th Eurovision Song Contest in Vienna, which was scheduled for 12 | 14 | 16 May 2026.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume the host city is a giant capital like London or Berlin; the reasoning path is remembering which country won the year before, which points to Austria and its capital.
extra.verification_notes: EBU officially confirmed Vienna as host city for the 70th Eurovision Song Contest, held 12-16 May 2026 at Wiener Stadthalle: https://www.ebu.ch/news/2025/08/vienna-revealed-as-host-city-for-70th-eurovision-song-contest-in-2026

explanation: Austria's win in 2025 earned it the hosting rights, and Vienna staged the anniversary edition with presenters Victoria Swarovski and Michael Ostrowski.

question: Which former One Direction member scored two global number-one singles in 2026 with 'Aperture' and 'American Girls'?
source_excerpt: Occasionally (2026), featured the global number-one singles "Aperture" and "American Girls".

extra.why_interesting: The boy-band framing narrows the field to five former members, and the player has to work out which of them is still topping global charts a decade after the band split.
extra.verification_notes: Both 'Aperture' (Jan 2026) and 'American Girls' (Mar 2026) are confirmed Harry Styles singles that each reached No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200 chart, per Wikipedia and Billboard.

explanation: Both songs came from his 2026 album Occasionally, extending a solo run that has already collected six Brit Awards and three Grammys.

question: Which rapper, also famous as Rihanna's partner, ended an eight-year album drought in 2026 with 'Don't Be Dumb'?
source_excerpt: A$AP Rocky released Don't Be Dumb in 2026, his first studio album in eight years.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a rapper this visible in fashion and tabloids has been releasing music constantly; the reveal is that he went eight full years without a studio album.
extra.verification_notes: Wikipedia and Billboard confirm A$AP Rocky released 'Don't Be Dumb' on January 16, 2026, his first album since Testing (2018), and he is publicly known as Rihanna's partner.

explanation: Despite constant headlines from fashion runways and his relationship with Rihanna, it was his first studio album since 2018.

question: The most-nominated Black woman in Oscar history, with five nominations by 2026, works behind the camera in which craft category?
source_excerpt: With her fifth Best Costume Design nomination, Ruth E. Carter became the most-nominated Black woman in Oscar history across all categories.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume the record holder must be a star actress; the answer overturns that with a behind-the-scenes craft, and the Black Panther costumes give a reasoning path.
extra.verification_notes: Ruth E. Carter's 5th nomination (Costume Design, for Sinners, 2026 ceremony) made her the most-nominated Black woman in Oscar history, per Variety: https://variety.com/2026/film/awards/ruth-e-carter-most-nominated-black-woman-oscars-history-1236632808/

explanation: Ruth E. Carter, who dressed the world of Black Panther, collected her fifth costume nomination in 2026 and passed every actress on the list.

question: Which thrash metal band, founded by a guitarist fired from Metallica, released a self-titled farewell album in January 2026?
source_excerpt: Megadeth announced and detailed a self-titled final album due January 23, 2026.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a farewell album from a metal giant would be Metallica; the twist is that it is the band built by the man Metallica threw out, and that origin story is the deduction path.
extra.verification_notes: Megadeth, founded by Dave Mustaine after his 1983 firing from Metallica, released its self-titled final/farewell album on January 23, 2026, confirmed by multiple sources including Wikipedia and music press.

explanation: Dave Mustaine closed more than four decades of Megadeth with an album that simply carried the band's own name.

question: The 2026 Disney+ series Wonder Man pairs its hero with which washed-up actor from Iron Man 3, who once posed as a supervillain?
source_excerpt: Sharing continuity with the films of the MCU, the series follows actors Simon Williams and Trevor Slattery.

extra.why_interesting: Players expect a new Marvel series to pair its hero with a big-name Avenger; the reveal is that the sidekick is the fraudulent fake villain from Iron Man 3, a character most viewers assumed was a one-off joke.
extra.verification_notes: Ben Kingsley reprises Trevor Slattery, the failed actor who posed as the Mandarin in Iron Man 3, opposite Simon Williams in Wonder Man (Disney+, premiered Jan 27, 2026); confirmed via IMDb and Marvel.com

explanation: Ben Kingsley's fake Mandarin returns as a struggling Hollywood actor, and the show follows the two performers chasing roles in a superhero-filled movie business.

question: The 2026 horror film Obsession became the highest grossing release ever for its studio, Focus Features. Roughly how big was its production budget in US dollars?
source_excerpt: Obsession became Focus Features' highest grossing domestic release in its history, and is one of the most profitable in history having been produced on a $750,000 budget.

extra.why_interesting: A studio's biggest box-office earner sounds like a blockbuster with a blockbuster budget, so players reach for tens of millions. The reveal is that it cost less than a million dollars, roughly the price of a single TV commercial, which is why it ranks among the most profitable films ever.
extra.verification_notes: Multiple sources confirm Obsession (2026) had a ~$750,000 production budget and became Focus Features' highest-grossing release ever, surpassing Downton Abbey; see https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-obsession-record-1236949178/

explanation: It was shot for about 750 thousand dollars, which turned a modest indie horror into one of the most profitable movies in cinema history.

question: Glastonbury Festival went ahead as usual in the summer of 2026. True or false?
source_excerpt: There will be no Glastonbury in 2026 as the Festival is taking a fallow year.

extra.why_interesting: Glastonbury feels like a fixture of every British summer, so players assume it happened; 2026 was one of its planned rest years.
extra.verification_notes: Glastonbury is taking a planned fallow year in 2026 with no festival, next edition confirmed for 23-27 June 2027 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glastonbury_Festival), confirming the claimed answer of False.

explanation: 2026 was a fallow year, when the festival skips a summer entirely so the farmland it sits on can recover.

question: At the 2026 Oscars, which craft category crowned its first-ever female winner, nearly a century after the first ceremony?
source_excerpt: Best Cinematography winner Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first female and Black winner in the category as well as the first Filipino winner

extra.why_interesting: Players assume the big first-woman barriers fell long ago, with Kathryn Bigelow winning Best Director in 2010; cinematography waited until 2026.
extra.verification_notes: Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars, confirmed as the category's first-ever female winner in its 98-year history per Variety and Hollywood Reporter.

explanation: Autumn Durald Arkapaw took the award, becoming the first woman, the first Black winner and the first Filipino winner in the category.
